MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

2. When learning Fundamentals of Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Media Technology.

3. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Production.

4. When learning Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.

5. When learning Pre- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

6. When learning Live streaming Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Live streaming Project.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Live streaming Project.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Live streaming Project.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Live streaming Project.

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

8. When learning Photography: technology and techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Photography: technology and techniques.

9. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.

10. When learning Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

13. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.

14. ICT stands for: (1 mark)

15. When learning Photography: technology and techniques 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Pr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
